categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou UIGreen Micro&Nano Technologies Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three segments: MEMS microelectronic components, semiconductor chip testing probes, and micro drive systems. The company focuses on R&D, design, production, and sales of these precision micro-manufactured products, serving semiconductor testing and microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) markets, as well as intelligent home appliance drive solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced micro-precision manufacturing technologies including multi-row mold design, high-speed production processes, micro bimetal shielding, micro resistance welding, complex deep drawing, and micro semiconductor chip testing probe manufacturing techniques. It emphasizes automation in probe assembly, high-frequency and high-current testing probes, and innovative MEMS component fabrication, supported by ISO9001, IATF16949, ISO14001, and ISO50001 management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global semiconductor chip and packaging testing companies, MEMS manufacturers, and intelligent home appliance brands. The company serves industries such as consumer electronics, semiconductor manufacturing and testing, AI-driven applications, IoT, automotive electronics, and industrial automation, with major clients like Tineco, GoerTek, NVIDIA, Resideo, and UNISEM.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, and has expanded its global footprint with subsidiaries and marketing networks in the United States, Japan, Switzerland, Singapore, and the Philippines. Overseas operations support sales, R&D, and manufacturing to serve international customers and leverage regional advantages.
categories.supply_chain_position: UIGreen operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor and MEMS supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and supply of precision micro-components and testing probes used by semiconductor foundries, packaging and testing service providers, and MEMS device manufacturers. It also extends into downstream applications via micro drive systems for intelligent appliances.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and product upgrades in semiconductor testing probes and MEMS components, with ongoing R&D in wafer-level packaging probes, high-frequency and high-current testing sockets, and micro drive systems. It invests heavily in R&D (~10% of revenue), collaborates with academic and research institutions, and pursues global market expansion and talent development to maintain competitive advantages and support domestic substitution trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision microelectronic components, semiconductor chip testing probes, and micro drive systems. The company employs a direct sales model with some VMI consignment inventory arrangements, serving both domestic and international customers. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: UIGreen is positioned as a strong competitor domestically in the semiconductor chip testing probe and MEMS microcomponent markets, recognized as a supplier to leading international semiconductor and MEMS companies. It holds a competitive edge through advanced manufacturing capabilities, technological innovation, and a growing global customer base amid increasing domestic substitution in the semiconductor industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, UIGreen reported revenues of approximately RMB 569 million, nearly doubling from the previous year, reflecting strong growth driven by market recovery and new product adoption. Despite ongoing net losses, the company has improved profitability metrics and cash flow from operations. Total assets reached about RMB 1.4 billion, with continued investments in R&D and capacity expansion supporting a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: UIGreen emphasizes high-precision manufacturing, advanced microfabrication technologies, and customized solutions tailored to customer-specific applications. Its products feature superior processing accuracy, complex microstructures, high environmental adaptability, and high yield rates in mass production. The company’s integrated global service network and commitment to quality and innovation create strong customer trust and competitive differentiation.
